description: Identify the organization that operates a domain. Returns a Markdown summary and structured output with ranked candidate entities, a confidence score for each, and the evidence behind it. Input is a bare hostname such as 'example.com', with no scheme, path or port. IP addresses are not accepted. This tool runs a fast subset of checks and usually answers within about half a minute. The analysis itself is cut off after 24 seconds. For a deep analysis, use the asynchronous REST API (POST /analyze). Cost: 1 credit, the same as a quick analysis on the REST API. A call that fails or runs out of time is not charged. The sandbox domains test-corp.whoisgeni.us and test-unknown.whoisgeni.us return a fixed sample result at no cost.
